key_insight: SOTA turns option trading into structured strategy selection, letting an LLM-based agent choose among option strategies while deterministic resolvers build the final contracts and positions.
engineering_relevance: The framework shows how agentic AI can manage combinatorial financial decision spaces by separating high-level policy selection from lower-level execution logic.
method: Post-train Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning, then reinforcement learning.
Map the large option universe into strategy-level actions instead of fixed handcrafted structures.
Use deterministic resolvers to translate strategy choices into executable option portfolios.
evidence_signal: On options for nine large-cap U.S. equities plus SPY, SOTA achieved 18.3% total return, a 1.60 Sharpe ratio, and 8.96% max drawdown over six months out of sample.
watch_item: News context helps during supervised/frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining it during reinforcement learning sharply hurt out-of-sample performance, suggesting sensitivity to training-stage information leakage or overfitting.
paper_title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
